title: Al-Rawd al-Murbi' Sharh Zad al-Mustaqni'
author: al-buhuti
attributionNote: The attribution is the one the manuscript tradition and the scholarship give.
description: Al-Buhuti's commentary on al-Hajjawi's Zad al-Mustaqni', a brief Hanbali manual. Text and commentary together give the settled later Hanbali position on each question, which is why the book is still the usual intermediate text of the school.
historicalContext: Mansur al-Buhuti was the leading Hanbali of Ottoman Cairo, and his commentaries define what later Hanbalis call the school's relied-upon doctrine.
availabilityNote: Arabic text only, streamed from OpenITI at read time. No English translation is included because no public-domain English translation was verified. Only the catalogue record, chapter outline and passage index are held here.
